versions.changelog: Make the skill operational for real use: add a concrete login-enhanced workflow, account-summary templates, minimal no-login user-input fallback paths, and stronger guidance for hybrid public-web plus user-provided evidence research.

Add dual access modes to the skill: default public-web research plus optional login-enhanced browser review when the user explicitly chooses deeper coverage. Document the login decision path, account-summary escalation flow, and clearer caveats for partial no-login coverage.

Expand the RedNote/Xiaohongshu public-web research skill with multimodal analysis guidance, recovery-oriented query generation from snippets/OCR/subtitles, structured claim-log tooling, stronger verification patterns, a scoring rubric, and reusable report templates.
Privacy scrub; stronger workflows and reliability caveats; improved query builder with aliases/geo/verification families; added verification patterns reference.
Initial release: public-web RedNote/Xiaohongshu reputation research workflow with query builder and scoring rubric.
